unsafe_justifications: No unsafe code, architecture intrinsics, pointer dereferences, or target-feature functions are introduced, including in tests.

load_block validates the original usize length with the frozen root valid_mask helper before slicing or copying. copy_from_slice reads exactly the supplied bytes into a zero-initialized 64-byte array without alignment or padding requirements.

classify_scalar_raw iterates a fixed 64-byte array, so each bit shift is bounded to positions 0 through 63. Unsigned byte predicates implement the complete raw classification rules with an explicit Scalar backend.

Production functions use only core operations and root-owned types or helpers. They allocate nothing, require no std or CPU features, and never call classify, quotes, or structural, preserving the acyclic fallback graph.

Integration tests invoke only safe scanner entry points, allowing existing dispatchers to establish AVX2 support before any vector instructions execute. Direct scalar assertions run regardless of host support.

test_vectors.coverage: Exact public signatures and literal expectations for all twelve raw masks, including whitespace/control overlap, ASCII digits, and high bytes.
All 65 accepted lengths at all 32 vector-relative address alignments, surrounding sentinels, exact prefix preservation, zero tails, and unchanged source storage.
Empty and exact one-, two-, and three-byte objects, plus every suffix of a 64-byte object. These are safe bounded-storage assertions, not guard-page execution claims.
Lengths 65, 66, 127, 128, 255, 256, and 1024; InvalidToken, Scanner source, offset zero, zero schema and field identifiers, nonempty detail, and length-error precedence over invalid carry.
All 256 uniform blocks and every byte value isolated at every one of 64 positions. Independent per-class predicates compare scalar, structural, and dispatched raw paths.
Explicit masks at positions 0, 31, 32, and 63, with quote/backslash roles exchanged across the lane boundary and full-block quote integration.

All lengths 0 through 64 for mixed, zero, ordinary ASCII, quote, backslash, and high-byte blocks under all four canonical quote states. Independently modeled ABI fields and final carry are compared with both the scalar composition and dispatched pipeline.
Every backslash-tail length, exact raw padding control bits, zero observable padding bits, and preserved trailing parity for both incoming escape states.
128 xorshift vectors using seed 0x64702ac9ef813b5d, alternating arbitrary bytes and a JSON-focused alphabet. Ten boundary lengths and all canonical incoming quote states.

Every split from 0 through 64 for mixed, all-backslash, and all-quote blocks, with an intervening empty block. All fifteen ABI mask fields reassemble to the continuous bytewise reference, and final carry agrees.
Three full backslash blocks followed by every tail length and a quote/colon suffix, under both incoming escape parities. Exact string and structural masks verify carry propagation.

Malformed punctuation, unfinished strings, invalid escapes, embedded controls, invalid UTF-8, and Unicode whitespace/digits remain classifiable. Literal escaped-quote and punctuation-in-string assertions verify raw-mask preservation.

Noncanonical carry values 2, 3, 255, 2^32, 2^63, and u64::MAX in either quote field at all accepted slice lengths and the fixed-array entry point. Exact scanner error metadata and unchanged carry are asserted.
Every live quote/backslash overlap position at every valid length, overlapping padding bits, and every invalid quote length 65 through 255. Error paths preserve carry.
Every possible utf8_tail_len value, opaque tail bytes, empty and nonempty successful inputs, and oversized-input failure.
Conditionally compiled on non-x86 targets or no-std configurations without static AVX2. Requires false support detection and Scalar backend tags for every accepted length.
